import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
solve_quadratic = gsl.gsl_poly_solve_quadratic
solve_quadratic.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
solve_quadratic.restype = ctypes.c_int

def compute_quadratic_roots(a, b, c):
    x0 = ctypes.c_double()
    x1 = ctypes.c_double()
    result = solve_quadratic(a, b, c, ctypes.byref(x0), ctypes.byref(x1))
    if result == 0:
        return None
    if a == 0:
        return (x0.value,)
    return (x0.value, x1.value)

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Real and distinct roots
    roots = compute_quadratic_roots(1, -3, 2)
    assert roots == (1.0, 2.0), f"Expected (1.0, 2.0), got {roots}"
    
    # Test case 2: Real and equal roots
    roots = compute_quadratic_roots(1, -2, 1)
    assert roots == (1.0, 1.0), f"Expected (1.0, 1.0), got {roots}"
    
    # Test case 3: Complex roots
    roots = compute_quadratic_roots(1, 0, 1)
    assert roots is None, f"Expected None, got {roots}"
    
    # Test case 4: Linear equation
    roots = compute_quadratic_roots(0, 2, -4)
    assert roots == (2.0,), f"Expected (2.0,), got {roots}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
